data.one_liner: Pure Dart QR code detection and decoding from raw RGBA image bytes
data.what_it_does: It scans a single QR code in an image, returns its location, type and decoded content. It can also track the QR across frames for AR use.
use_when: You need a lightweight, pure Dart QR decoder without native dependencies
You want to process images from any source (camera, file, network) in Flutter or Dart CLI
You need to track a QR code position between frames for AR or overlay purposes
avoid_when: You need to detect multiple QR codes in the same image
You require high performance on large images or low‑noise environments
You need a fully featured camera preview and barcode scanning widget
strengths: Pure Dart, no native code or platform channels
Supports tracking across frames and perspective transforms
Easy to integrate into existing image pipelines
weaknesses: Performance can be poor on large or noisy images

alternatives.name: zxing2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure Dart barcode/QR decoder with multi‑code support and better performance

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: Native MLKit implementation with high accuracy and multi‑code support
